content.text: {"core": "Drive pushes forward — one direction chosen, everything else set aside, momentum carrying the whole body toward it. In Discipline, that push lands on the slow solitary work of tending one thing until it holds. Overdone, the pace outruns the tending: the practice gets driven faster than it can settle, and the forward motion strips the patience the work was built on. What needed sitting-with gets shoved ahead.", "sheetLine": "The steady work is being driven faster than it can hold."}
